package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.external

import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.AccessPathBase
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.driver.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.Target
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.fixtures.DriverFixtures
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.CallPoint.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.StageKind.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.*
import kotlin.time.Duration.Companion.seconds

private class CapturedOut : LocalRelationOut {
    val rows = ArrayList<Pair<PremiseKey,Facts>>()
    override fun data(original: PremiseKey, value: Facts) { rows += original to value }
    override fun target(original: PremiseKey, target: Target) = Unit
    override fun markRequest(mark: TaintMark) = Unit
}

fun main() = DriverFixtures().use { f ->
    val p = f.program
    fun straight(n: Int) = List(n) { if (it+1<n) listOf(it+1) else emptyList() }
    val root = p.method("main",straight(3),2).key()
    val helper = p.method("helper",straight(4),3).key()
    val x = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
    val y = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(1)
    val tmp = AccessPathBase.LocalVar(0)
    val arg = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
    val ret = AccessPathBase.Return
    val field = p.field("f")
    val t = MarkSlot.Concrete(p.mark("T"))
    val u = MarkSlot.Concrete(p.mark("U"))
    val source = PathEdge(ZERO_FACT, p.pattern(x, tail=Tail.ANY_TAINT,mark=t).fact,ExclusionSet.Empty)
    p.entry(root,RuleStatement(f.summary(ZERO_KEEP,source),StatementSummary.EMPTY,emptyList()))
    p.call(root,1,CallPlan(setOf(x,y),listOf(
        CallStage.Edges(BEFORE,AFTER,PASS_OVER,f.summary(keepEdge(x))),
        CallStage.Edges(BEFORE,BOUND,BIND_IN,f.summary(ZERO_KEEP,starEdge(x,emptyList(),arg,emptyList()))),
        CallStage.Actions(BOUND,ADDED,emptyList()),
        CallStage.Callees(ADDED,RETURNED,listOf(helper)),
        CallStage.Actions(RETURNED,REWRITTEN,emptyList()),
        CallStage.Edges(REWRITTEN,AFTER,BIND_BACK,f.summary(ZERO_KEEP,starEdge(ret,emptyList(),y,emptyList())))
    ),emptyList(),BEFORE,AFTER))
    p.statement(helper,1,MicroEdgeBuilder().apply { read(tmp,arg,listOf(field)) }.build())
    // Lowered conditional source at transform(tmp): CM(tmp,T) -> assign U to ret.$.
    p.statement(helper,2,f.summary(PathEdge(p.pattern(tmp,mark=t).fact,p.pattern(ret,mark=u).fact,ExclusionSet.Empty)))
    val sink = SinkRule(f.rule("sink U"),0,listOf(p.pattern(y,mark=u)),emptyList())
    p.exit(root,2,ExitRules(RuleStatement(StatementSummary.EMPTY,StatementSummary.EMPTY,listOf(sink)),false,emptySet()))
    fun fmt(value: Facts) = value.layer.toString()+":"+f.ops.leaves(value).joinToString("|")
    val actual = f.manager.factsOf(p.pattern(arg,tail=Tail.ANY_TAINT,mark=t).fact,ExclusionSet.Empty,Layer.NORMAL)
    var savedViews=0
    var applicableViews=0
    var insideViews=0
    var nativeOutput=0
    val result=f.driver(FixedLimits(listOf(1,1,2)),budget=20.seconds,invokeRun={config,shared,timeout ->
        println("CONFIG run=${config.index} helper-demand="+config.demand?.explicitRows(helper))
        if(config.index==3) {
            println("RUN3_ACTUAL "+fmt(actual))
            val application=LocalRelationApplication(f.ops,ApMode(false,Direction.FORWARD,2))
            for(record in f.records.byExit(helper,p.pattern(arg,tail=Tail.ANY_TAINT,mark=t)).toList().distinct()) {
                println("SAVED_RAW ${record.direction} ${record.premise.toPattern()} -> ${fmt(record.conclusion)}")
                if(record.direction==Direction.BACKWARD) for(leaf in f.ops.leaves(actual)) record.forEachReversedAt(leaf) { view,protected ->
                    savedViews++
                    val app=applicable(view.premise,leaf,f.manager.marks)
                    val ins=inside(view.premise,leaf,f.manager.marks)
                    if(app)applicableViews++
                    if(ins)insideViews++
                    val out=CapturedOut()
                    application.applyRecordView(actual,f.manager.zero,view,protected,out)
                    nativeOutput+=out.rows.size
                    println("RUN3_VIEW ${view.premise} -> ${view.result} applicable=$app inside=$ins output="+out.rows.map { fmt(it.second) })
                }
            }
        }
        f.run(config,shared,timeout)
    },run1MarkMode=MarkMode.FULL).analyze(listOf(root))
    for((index,r)in f.results.withIndex())for(a in r.analyzers.filter { it.key==helper }) {
        println("HELPER_SUMMARIES run=${index+1} "+a.summaries.all().map { (i,g)-> i.members.map { it.toPattern() }.toString()+" -> "+fmt(g) }.toList())
    }
    for(row in f.processed.filter { it.method==helper })println("PROCESSED run=${row.run} original=${row.delta.premise.members.map { it.toPattern() }} value=${fmt(row.delta.facts)}")
    println("RESULT latest=run-${result.end.run} status=${result.end.status} findings="+result.entries.map { it.descriptor.key.ruleId })
    println("VIEW_COUNTS total=$savedViews applicable=$applicableViews inside=$insideViews outputs=$nativeOutput")
    check(result.entries.any { it.descriptor.key.ruleId==sink.rule.id })
    check(savedViews>0 && applicableViews==0 && insideViews>0 && nativeOutput>0)
    println("INSIDE_POLICY_PROBE PASS")
}
